Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (October 11, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 6028-18-0069 Description: For the non-exclusive supply of all labour, materials and equipment and supplies necessary to provide warranty and non-warranty maintenance, repairs and replacement of O.E.M. Keith Walking Floor Systems and Main Hydraulic System Components for the City of Toronto's Fleet Services Division from October 1, 2018 to September 30, 2019 with the option to renew the contract for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods.
